Summary by CodeRabbit

Release Notes

  • New Features

    • Added per-layer KV cache mixed-precision support—configure different data types for different transformer layers to optimize memory and performance.
    • Introduced flexible KV cache dtype specification: uniform, layer-range syntax, or per-layer mapping.
    • Enhanced batch sequence processing for improved KV cache allocation efficiency.

  • Bug Fixes

    • Corrected FP4/scale memory accounting calculations.

  • Documentation

    • Added debug logging for KV cache buffer initialization and reuse analysis.

root and others added 3 commits April 28, 2026 15:58
[TRTLLM-None][feat] Add mixed-precision per-layer KV cache dtype support
15c3d0c 
Extends KVCacheManager V1 to support per-layer KV cache dtypes (e.g.,
"0-3:fp8,4-35:nvfp4") by grouping pools in WindowBlockManager by
(numKvHeads, dtype) instead of numKvHeads alone, replacing the previous
MixedPrecisionKVCacheManager wrapper with a single unified manager.

- C++: WindowBlockManager accepts optional perLayerDtype map; each pool
  tracks its own DataType; block-scale pools created only for FP4 pools;
  getBlockScalePoolPointers returns (numKVPools, 2) with zeros for non-FP4
- Python KVCacheManager: adds per_layer_dtype param, weighted
  get_cache_bytes_per_token(), removes MixedPrecisionKVCacheManager
- _util.py: _create_kv_cache_manager uses per_layer_dtype directly;
  removes _create_mixed_kv_cache_manager and _get_bytes_per_token
- llm_args.py: parse_kv_cache_dtype_spec validates start <= end
- Tests: test_kv_cache_dtype_spec.py (8 new tests),
  test_kv_cache_dtype_override.py (2 new tests)

Signed-off-by: root <root@research-common-b200-01.cloud.together.ai-devel>

📝 Walkthrough

Walkthrough

The changes introduce per-layer KV cache dtype support and refactor the prefix-reuse workflow in KV cache management. Key updates include threading perLayerDtype through manager constructors, replacing prefix-reuse probing with a new analyzePrefixReuse API, and implementing a multi-request two-phase batch allocation workflow. Python bindings and configuration interfaces are extended to support per-layer dtype specifications via range syntax or per-layer dicts.

Changes

Cohort / File(s) Summary
Core C++ KV Cache Manager
cpp/tensorrt_llm/batch_manager/kvCacheManager.cpp		 Adds per-layer dtype support via perLayerDtype map threaded through constructors; replaces findNewContextBlock/countReusableBlocks with new analyzePrefixReuse returning PrefixReuseSummary; introduces addSequenceBatch implementing two-phase batch prefix-reuse workflow; updates FP4/FP8 scale memory accounting; extends getNeededBlocksOneStep and getRemainingBlocksToCompletion to accept optional cached summary.
Python Bindings
cpp/tensorrt_llm/nanobind/batch_manager/kvCacheManager.cpp		 Exposes new batch and prefix-reuse APIs (addSequenceBatch, analyzePrefixReuse); adds PrefixReuseSummary Python binding; enhances BlockKey with __eq__ and __hash__; updates constructor signature to include per_layer_dtype; rebinds scheduling methods with explicit cached_summary default.
Attention Operator
cpp/tensorrt_llm/thop/attentionOp.cpp		 Updates buildKvCachePoolPointers to handle 2D and 3D hostKvCachePoolPointers tensor layouts for mixed-precision KV caches; removes strict 2D constraint; computes pool pointers from appropriately dimensioned indices.
Torch Linear Module
tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py		 Adds kv_scales and inv_kv_scales frozen parameters to FP8 QDQ and rowwise linear initialization for NVFP4 KV-cache scale handling.
Executor Utilities
tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/_util.py, tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/model_loader.py		 Adds per-layer KV cache dtype parsing and passing to manager construction; extends V1 VSWA speculative decoding budgeting to split bytes between target and draft; detects per-layer dtype specs to skip global quantization override.
Resource Manager
tensorrt_llm/_torch/pyexecutor/resource_manager.py		 Adds per_layer_dtype storage and forwarding; updates KV cache byte accounting to compute per-layer; reworks prefix-reuse probing to use analyze_prefix_reuse; refactors first-context KV allocation and dummy sequence allocation into batched paths; adds history_length hints to align block optimization.
LLM API Configuration
tensorrt_llm/llmapi/llm_args.py		 Adds TOKENIZER_ALIASES constant; introduces parse_kv_cache_dtype_spec function supporting uniform, range-syntax, and per-layer dict formats; updates KvCacheConfig.dtype to Union[str, Dict[int, str]]; extends validator to accept dicts and range-syntax strings.
Tests
tests/unittest/llmapi/test_kv_cache_dtype_override.py, tests/unittest/llmapi/test_kv_cache_dtype_spec.py		 Adds validation tests for range-based dtype specs and dedicated unit tests for parse_kv_cache_dtype_spec covering uniform/range/dict parsing and error cases.

Sequence Diagram

sequenceDiagram
    participant Client as KVCacheManager
    participant BlockMgr as BlockManager
    participant WinBlockMgr as WindowBlockManager
    participant RadixTree as PrefixRadixTree
    participant MemPool as MemoryPool

    Client->>Client: addSequenceBatch(requestInfos, llmRequests)
    Client->>Client: For each window size, dispatch to BlockManager
    
    Client->>BlockMgr: addSequenceBatch(sequences, inputLengths,<br/>numContextBlocks, llmRequests)
    BlockMgr->>WinBlockMgr: addSequenceBatch(Phase 1 & 2 workflow)
    
    activate WinBlockMgr
    WinBlockMgr->>RadixTree: Phase 1: Claim matching blocks<br/>via PrefixReuseTracker
    RadixTree-->>WinBlockMgr: Block match results
    
    WinBlockMgr->>MemPool: Phase 2: Onboard/allocate blocks<br/>(copy vs reuse vs placeholder)
    MemPool-->>WinBlockMgr: Allocation complete
    WinBlockMgr-->>BlockMgr: Update LlmRequest with<br/>alloc/reuse/miss deltas
    deactivate WinBlockMgr
    
    BlockMgr-->>Client: Batch allocation summary
    Client->>LlmRequest: Accumulate per-request<br/>allocation results
